decision: Stop dictionary and Galerkin expansion. Interval-certify the fixed rational atomic Green-kernel witness at alpha=21/20.
why: Nested Galerkin and an independent direct Green solver agree at the selected point to about 1e-9.
The frozen atomic measures retain a direct continuous-kernel floating threshold about 1.1324412.
At alpha=21/20 the rationalized witness has a floating full margin about 0.31224325 and Schur margin about 0.06988523.
Only two core-imaginary negative directions remain, reducing infinite-dimensional PSD to a two-by-two Schur test.
first_actions: Implement interval or ball evaluation of the explicit clamped Green pairings.
Certify invertibility of the two-by-two structural Gram matrix.
Build interval enclosures for every projected pairing used by the 62 evaluation vectors.
Perform a verified solve of the positive 60-by-60 system.
Prove the final two-by-two Schur matrix is positive definite at alpha=21/20.
Separately certify the tail and five count coefficients against their zeta-facing source theorems.

success_gate.layer_A: A machine-checkable interval proof that the abstract continuous witness W_{21/20} is positive semidefinite.
success_gate.layer_B: Directed theorem-backed validation that the rational tail and count coefficients are conservative for the intended explicit-formula model.
success_gate.scope: A certified continuous-model obstruction for one patch; not RH closure.

stop_rules: Do not return to dictionary search.
Do not replace interval arithmetic with ordinary high precision.
Do not expand to other patches before Layer A is complete.
Do not merge abstract-model certification with zeta coefficient legitimacy.
forbidden_inferences: Floating Green convergence is already an interval certificate.
An abstract continuous obstruction proves RH.
One patch closes all off-axis leakage regions.
Weak duality requires an unproved strong-duality theorem.
